subject: MAP & eval artifact sharing: dataset + prompt-pack constraints
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@acmefin.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP & eval artifact sharing: dataset + prompt-pack constraints

Hi Elena and Samir,

Thanks again for the demo. As discussed, we'd like to move forward with a short mutual action plan (MAP) to exchange evaluation artifacts so your team can validate model fit on representative data and our prompt suite. Draft MAP attached. Key asks from our side: 

- Share a representative evaluation dataset or grant us temporary, scoped access so we can run the eval.
- Provide the prompt pack and test cases (format: JSONL or CSV with ground truth where applicable).
- Agree on usage constraints: limited to evaluation purposes only; no redistribution; no commercial production use of the raw artifacts; delete artifacts after 90 days unless you request extension; label artifacts as property of Acme Financial in outputs.

Security and hosting options we support: customer-managed S3 in VPC (preferred for PII), temporary Redwood encrypted bucket (KMS) for non-PII, or SFTP transfer. We can provide audit logs and an ACL for read-only evaluation.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Sign MAP (paperwork) by Mon Feb 23
- Redwood receives artifacts by Thu Feb 26
- 2-week evaluation window (Fri Feb 27 - Thu Mar 12)
- Internal review and demo week of Mon Mar 15
- Decision / next steps by Fri Mar 20

Next steps: please review the attached MAP_Acme_Redwood_v2.pdf and confirm preferred hosting option and any legal contacts for redlines. If you prefer, we can surface a limited redline today and ask legal to finalize by Feb 20.

Attachments: MAP_Acme_Redwood_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmefin.com>, Bruno Legal <bruno.legal@acmefin.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & eval artifact sharing: dataset + prompt-pack constraints

Thanks Rishi — we like the structure and the proposed dates. A few items from our side: 

- Our legal team will want a slightly more explicit IP and derivative-use clause. Looping in Bruno (cc).
- Can Redwood host the dataset in an isolated S3 bucket owned by Acme but managed by Redwood? That is our preferred mechanism for any datasets with customer identifiers. If not, can you confirm encryption and audit capabilities for the temporary bucket?
- What is the approximate size and file-format of the prompt pack you need? We have multiple prompt variations and want to ensure you get the canonical set.

Tentatively ok to aim for signing Feb 23, but Bruno will review redlines and likely provide an initial markup by end of business Fri Feb 20.

Elena
VP, Data Science | Acme Financial
elena@acmefin.com

Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & eval artifact sharing: dataset + prompt-pack constraints

Elena — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Bruno. Quick clarifications and an explicit MAP milestone list below.

1) Hosting options and security
- For datasets containing customer identifiers or any regulated data we require customer-managed S3 with a cross-account role. That keeps data in your account while granting Redwood ephemeral read access. If you prefer us to host, we will create an encrypted, scoped bucket (Redwood account) and apply KMS keys and strict ACLs; audit logs are available and we'll provide them weekly.

2) Prompt pack format and size
- Preferred: JSONL with a prompt and expected output columns; for classification tasks include label column. Typical prompt pack for a mid-sized use case is 5k-20k rows; if you have a smaller canonical set, send that and we will augment with synthetic variations if you want.

3) Proposed MAP milestones (we can update based on Bruno's redlines):
- Tue Feb 23: Signed MAP executed
- Thu Feb 26: Acme uploads dataset + prompt pack to agreed location
- Fri Feb 27 - Thu Mar 12: Redwood runs evaluation harness, shares interim results weekly
- Mon Mar 15: Joint demo of failure modes + suggested guardrails
- Fri Mar 20: Decision on pilot/POC or additional work

Notes: We will treat all artifacts as evaluation-only per MAP; any shared derivatives (aggregated metrics, error bins) will be stripped of raw identifiers. If Acme needs longer retention for troubleshooting, we can document exceptions in the MAP.

HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345-DEAL-ACME-1024
DocuSign (MAP): https://www.docusign.net/link/Acme-Redwood-MAP-v2

Attachments referenced: acme_eval_prompt_pack_v1.zip (stub - please upload canonical prompt pack to the agreed location)

Can Bruno flag the specific IP language he'd like changed and we will return a narrow redline focused only on evaluation constraints and retention.

Thanks,
Rishi
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Bruno Legal <bruno.legal@acmefin.com>, Elena Morales <elena@acmefin.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MAP & eval artifact sharing: dataset + prompt-pack constraints — legal redline summary

Bruno — thanks for reviewing. I pulled together a short redline summary to speed discussion: 

- Usage scope: confirm "evaluation purposes only" and prohibit production use of raw artifacts and model outputs that reconstitute raw data.
- Retention: default 90 days post-engagement; extensions allowed by written mutual agreement.
- Derivatives: Redwood may produce aggregated, de-identified metrics and error analyses; those outputs will not contain raw records.
- IP: Acme retains ownership of the raw dataset and prompt pack; Redwood retains IP in its evaluation tooling and non-identifying performance improvements. We propose a narrow license back to Redwood limited to internal evaluation and improving model infra; no broad commercialization rights.
- Audit & deletion: Redwood will provide logs and a deletion certificate when assets are removed.

I attached a short operations note with exact upload instructions and preferred file naming conventions. Happy to take Bruno's redline and converge quickly.

Attachment: redwood_eval_instructions.txt (text/plain)

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

Marissa, can you confirm which internal team will handle the demo and availability in mid-March?
